a7-DlDDW-U1LWnW1LtH3hw.zh: 宏都拉斯疫情持續,今年截至9/23累計報告280例確定病例、22 例死亡,較去年全年報告114例增幅達145.6%,目前該國疫苗覆蓋率約80%,當局呼籲⺠眾落實常規疫苗接種。 哈薩克自2026年以來累計報告76例確定病例,其中以88%為未接種疫苗的兒童為主,當局推測較去年同期下降2.8倍,可能與該國持續進行疫苗接種和兒童補接種措施有關。當局亦將持續加強接種疫苗等衛教宣導。
a7-DlDDW-U1LWnW1LtH3hw.en: Pertussis transmission continues in Honduras. As of 23 September this year, 280 confirmed cases and 22 deaths have been reported, an increase of 145.6% over the 114 cases reported for the whole of last year. The country's vaccination coverage is approximately 80%, and authorities urge the public to follow routine vaccination schedules. Kazakhstan has reported 76 confirmed cases since the start of 2026, 88% of them unvaccinated children. Authorities estimate that cases are 2.8 times lower than in the same period last year, possibly due to ongoing vaccination and catch-up immunisation of children. Authorities will continue to strengthen vaccination and health education.

gVEXCTZBRWgKeLrWnjw0XQ.zh: 葉門馬里卜(Marib)今年8/2宣布公共衛生緊急狀態(Public health emergency),今年截至8/2,累計報告1,624例病例,其中僅290例確定病例,及12例相關死亡案例。因當地診斷能力嚴重受限,疫情實際負擔比報告病例數要高得多。由於戰亂導致未接種疫苗等,當局已擴大疫苗接種,防止疫情擴散。 哈薩克北部庫斯塔奈(Kostanay)今年上半年累計報告167例確定病例,較去年同期10例,增加16倍,其中57例(34.1%)為未滿1 歲嬰兒。近期顯示疫情在北部多個地區蔓延,⺠眾疫苗猶豫現象造成免疫覆蓋率偏低,疫情持續傳播 。另該國於2024年報告27,967例病例,成為當年歐洲區域麻疹負擔最重之國家。 馬達加斯加瓦卡南卡拉特拉(Vakinankaratra),截至今年7月中旬,累計報告229例確定病例,2例於8/4-5期間死亡;該國42區中,有24區處於活躍期,18區為監測期。由於該國去年疫苗覆蓋率僅72%,以及學校假期,增加兒童跨區互動,加速疫情擴散。當局已在受影響地區進行補接種疫苗,並預計今年10月展開全國大規模疫苗接種。 美國疫情持續,今年截至8/9,累計報告2,465例確定病例(含16 例境外移入),高於去年2,289例。有68%為19歲以下兒童及青少年,93%為未接種疫苗或接種史不明者,7%病患住院治療,病例數以南卡羅萊納州(670例)及猶他州(524例)為多。另賓州近期疫情快速上升,8/10之當週新增57例確定病例,今年累計達232例。
gVEXCTZBRWgKeLrWnjw0XQ.en: Yemen: Marib declared a public health emergency on 2 August this year. As of 2 August, 1,624 cases had been reported cumulatively, of which only 290 were confirmed, along with 12 related deaths. Because local diagnostic capacity is severely limited, the true disease burden is much higher than the reported case count. Owing to armed conflict and low vaccination, authorities have expanded vaccination to prevent the outbreak from spreading. Kazakhstan: in Kostanay in the north, 167 confirmed cases were reported cumulatively in the first half of this year, compared with 10 in the same period last year, a 16-fold increase; 57 (34.1%) were infants under 1 year old. Recent data show the outbreak is spreading across several northern areas. Vaccine hesitancy among residents has led to low immunity coverage, and transmission continues. In addition, the country reported 27,967 cases in 2024, making it the country with the heaviest measles burden in the European Region that year. Madagascar: in Vakinankaratra, 229 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively as of mid-July this year, and 2 died between 4 and 5 August. Of the country's 42 districts, 24 are in the active phase and 18 are under surveillance. Because vaccination coverage last year was only 72%, and school holidays increased inter-district contact among children, the outbreak has accelerated. Authorities have carried out catch-up vaccination in affected areas and plan to launch nationwide mass vaccination in October this year. United States: the outbreak continues. As of 9 August this year, 2,465 confirmed cases (including 16 imported) have been reported cumulatively, higher than the 2,289 cases last year. 68% were children and young people aged 19 and under, 93% were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history, and 7% of patients were hospitalised. The largest numbers are in South Carolina (670) and Utah (524). In Pennsylvania, the outbreak has risen rapidly recently; 57 confirmed cases were added in the week of 10 August, bringing the total this year to 232.

JCG5Z-gSaS0Vx3DyMo-DSQ.zh: 美國今年截至7/23,累計2,318例確定病例,已超越去年全年2,289例,19歲以下族群達1,581例,其中有10%之5歲以下兒童住院,且高達93%患者未接種疫苗或接種狀態不明。賓州迄7/27,過去7天新增報告31例確定病例,累計142例確定病例,為近期疫情上升地區之一。該國持續進行病例和接觸者調查、廢水監測與擴大疫苗接種等防治措施。 墨西哥疫情持續,今年截至7/24,累計報告12,335例確定病例,18例死亡,超越去年全年6,614例。其中以西部哈利斯科州(Jalisco)6,611例為多,墨西哥城(Ciudad de México)1,012例次之。確診人數以1-9歲孩童(4,753例)及25-29歲年輕成人(2,154 例)為好發族群。 哈薩克巴甫洛達爾州(Pavlodar)疫情上升,今年上半年已累積報告398例確定病例,有345例(87%)未接種疫苗,其中288例為14歲以下兒童。該國指出疫苗接種覆蓋率不足為此次爆發疫情的主要原因,該國已加強疫苗接種,並針對拒絕接種疫苗之家庭加強溝通。 瓜地馬拉(Guatemala)今年截至7/24,累計報告30,040例確定病例,29例死亡(CFR:0.1%) ,約10%個案住院,另15至39歲族群佔確定病例63%,1歲以下為高風險族群。
JCG5Z-gSaS0Vx3DyMo-DSQ.en: The United States has reported 2,318 confirmed cases cumulatively this year as of 23 July, exceeding last year's full-year total of 2,289. Cases aged under 19 years total 1,581, and 10% of children under 5 years have been hospitalized. As many as 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. Pennsylvania reported 31 new confirmed cases in the 7 days to 27 July, bringing its cumulative total to 142 confirmed cases, and it is one of the areas where the outbreak has recently increased. The country continues case and contact investigations, wastewater surveillance and expanded vaccination. Mexico's outbreak continues. As of 24 July this year, 12,335 confirmed cases and 18 deaths have been reported cumulatively, exceeding last year's total of 6,614. Jalisco State accounts for most cases (6,611), followed by Mexico City (1,012). Children aged 1 to 9 years (4,753 cases) and young adults aged 25 to 29 years (2,154 cases) are the most affected groups. In Pavlodar Region of Kazakhstan, cases are rising. In the first half of this year, 398 confirmed cases have been reported, of which 345 (87%) were unvaccinated, including 288 children aged under 14 years. The country identifies insufficient vaccination coverage as the main cause of this outbreak, has strengthened vaccination, and has enhanced communication with families who refuse vaccination. Guatemala has reported 30,040 confirmed cases cumulatively this year as of 24 July, including 29 deaths (CFR: 0.1%). About 10% of cases were hospitalized. People aged 15 to 39 years account for 63% of confirmed cases, and infants under 1 year are a high-risk group.

rYCJnMBVInLfXoX2bT_puQ.zh: 哈薩克疫情上升,今 (2026) 年截至2/20報告3,343例確定病例,其中84.2%為14歲以下兒童,另77.6%為未接種疫苗兒童,分布於阿斯塔納和阿拉木圖等9個地區。當局已發布防疫命令,包括擴大免疫接種運動、暫時禁止未接種疫苗兒童進入學校和幼稚園,以及強制醫護人員接種疫苗。 美國疫情持續,今(2026)年截至2/19共26州累計報告982例確定病例,其中38例住院,該國94%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明, 病例數以南卡羅來納州報告632例確定病例為多,其次為猶他州(117例)及佛羅里達州(64例),其中佛羅里達州病患主要與柯里爾郡(Collier)之聖母瑪利亞大學相關,該校已加強相關疫情防治措施。 墨西哥疫情持續,今年截至2/23累計報告4,497例確定病例,其中5例死亡,病例數以中西部哈利斯科州(2,662例)、南部恰帕斯州(393例)為多。該國自去(2025)年年初爆發疫情,2025年累計報告6,444例確定病例,其中27例死亡,其中以1-4歲嬰兒為多(1,548例)。 英國北倫敦地區爆發疫情,英蘭地區今年已累計96例確診病例,主要分布於倫敦及西密德蘭區域,病例以10歲以下兒童為多,2成之感染兒童住院治療中,所有住院兒童均未完全接種疫苗。當局已設立臨時疫苗接種所,鼓勵補接種疫苗。
rYCJnMBVInLfXoX2bT_puQ.en: Kazakhstan's outbreak is rising. As of 20 February this year, 3,343 confirmed cases have been reported, of which 84.2% were children under 14 years and 77.6% were unvaccinated children, distributed across nine regions including Astana and Almaty. Authorities have issued prevention orders, including expanding immunization campaigns, temporarily banning unvaccinated children from entering schools and kindergartens, and requiring health workers to be vaccinated. The United States outbreak continues: as of 19 February this year, 982 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively across 26 states, of which 38 were hospitalized; 94% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Cases are concentrated in South Carolina, with 632 confirmed cases, followed by Utah (117 cases) and Florida (64 cases). Florida's patients are mainly linked to Ave Maria University in Collier County, which has strengthened outbreak prevention and control measures. Mexico's outbreak continues: as of 23 February this year, 4,497 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, including 5 deaths; cases are concentrated in west-central Jalisco (2,662 cases) and southern Chiapas (393 cases). The outbreak in Mexico began in early last year; 6,444 confirmed cases, including 27 deaths, were reported in 2025, mainly among infants aged 1–4 years (1,548 cases). In north London, an outbreak has occurred: England has reported 96 confirmed cases so far this year, mainly in London and the West Midlands, mostly among children under 10 years. Twenty per cent of infected children are being treated in hospital, and all hospitalized children were not fully vaccinated. Authorities have set up temporary vaccination sites to encourage catch-up vaccination.

-pw8ozEkBzxxrnU8Lwugyg.zh: PAHO針對美洲區發布麻疹疫情警報,今(2026)年美洲區第1-3週共7國報告1,031例確定病例,分別為墨西哥(740例)、美國(171例)、加拿大(67例)、瓜地馬拉(41例)、玻利維亞(10例)、智利(1例)及烏拉圭(1例),較去(2025)年同期(23例)增加43倍,其中73%病患未接種疫苗,11%病患接種史不明,病例主要集中於青少年及青年族群中,另發病率以1歲以下嬰兒為高,其次為1-4歲及5-9歲兒童;去年該地區共計13國報告14,891例確定病例,2024年報告466例,近5年病例數持續增加,且多個國家持續出現疫情。PAHO呼籲各國加強流行病學監測、疫苗接種及緊急疫情防控措施,以阻斷疫情傳播。 歐洲去年共計30國報告7,655例病例,其中8例死亡,病例數以羅馬亞(4,198例)、法國(877例)、荷蘭(534例)、義大利(529例)及西班牙(426例)為多,其中79.9%病患未接種疫苗,病例數以5歲以下年齡層為多(佔40%),ECDC表示去年病例數較2024年(逾3.5萬例)下降,惟仍約2023年病例數兩倍,由於麻疹感染人數通常於冬末春初達到高峰,呼籲民眾檢視自身已完成疫苗接種。 哈薩克今年1月報告1,951例確定病例,病例數以中北部阿斯塔納州(581例)、東南部江布爾州(339例)及東南部阿拉木圖市(317例)為多,其中79%病患未接種疫苗,當局表示拒絕接種疫苗為疫情爆發主因,當局呼籲家長確認孩童疫苗接種情形,並依照國家免疫計畫及時接種疫苗;該國西部阿克托別州疫情嚴峻,單月報告逾百名病例,以3歲以下年齡層為主,其中24例兒童住院治療中。
-pw8ozEkBzxxrnU8Lwugyg.en: PAHO issued a measles outbreak alert for the Americas. In weeks 1–3 of this year, 7 countries in the Americas reported 1,031 confirmed cases: Mexico (740), the United States (171), Canada (67), Guatemala (41), Bolivia (10), Chile (1) and Uruguay (1). This is a 43-fold increase over the 23 cases in the same period last year. Of these cases, 73% were unvaccinated and 11% had unknown vaccination history. Cases were mainly concentrated among adolescents and young adults, and incidence was highest among infants under 1 year, followed by children aged 1–4 and 5–9 years. Last year, 13 countries in the region reported 14,891 confirmed cases, compared with 466 in 2024; cases have continued to increase over the past five years, and many countries continue to report outbreaks. PAHO calls on countries to strengthen epidemiological surveillance, vaccination and emergency outbreak control measures to stop transmission. Europe reported 7,655 cases across 30 countries last year, including 8 deaths. Cases were most numerous in Romania (4,198), France (877), the Netherlands (534), Italy (529) and Spain (426). Of these, 79.9% were unvaccinated, and cases were most numerous among children under 5 years (40%). ECDC said last year's case numbers declined from 2024 (more than 35,000), but remain about twice the 2023 level. Because measles infections usually peak in late winter and early spring, it urges people to check that they have completed their vaccinations. Kazakhstan reported 1,951 confirmed cases in January this year, most in Astana (581), Zhambyl Region in the southeast (339) and Almaty city in the southeast (317). Of these, 79% were unvaccinated. Authorities say refusal of vaccination is the main cause of the outbreak, and urge parents to confirm children's vaccination status and vaccinate them promptly under the national immunization programme. The outbreak is severe in Aktobe Region in the west, which reported more than 100 cases in a single month, mainly among children under 3 years; 24 children are being treated in hospital.

eu7ww-ye481FvTwsUHqNsQ.zh: 墨西哥疫情持續,今(2026)年第1-2週新增報告506例確定病例,其中逾5成病例來自中西部哈利斯科州,該國去年共計31州報告6,427例確定病例,其中24例死亡,病例數以西北部契瓦瓦州(70%)為多,PAHO預定於4/13邀集美國及墨西哥召開線上會議審查其麻疹消除情形。 哈薩克今年截至1/16累計報告370例確定病例,其中298例為14歲以下兒童,85%之感染兒童未接種疫苗,病例主要分布於東南部江布爾州(191例),該國去年報告4,240例病例,另推估2024年報告達2.4-2.8萬例,當局表示目標年齡層兒童的疫苗涵蓋率低,且拒絕接種的人數增加,致疫情持續。 美國今年共9州累計報告171例確定病例,其中2例住院,病例數以南卡羅來納州報告145例確定病例為多,該州已匡列409名接觸者並預定監測至2/9,該國95%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明。該國近年疫苗接種率持續落後,近期疫情集中於南卡羅來納/猶他州。
eu7ww-ye481FvTwsUHqNsQ.en: Measles continues in Mexico: in weeks 1–2 of 2026, 506 new confirmed cases were reported, more than half from Jalisco state in the central-west. Last year, the country reported 6,427 confirmed cases across 31 states, including 24 deaths; cases were most numerous in Chihuahua state in the northwest (70%). The Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) plans an online meeting with the United States and Mexico on 13 April to review their measles elimination status. Kazakhstan has reported 370 confirmed cases cumulatively as of 16 January this year, of which 298 were children under 14, and 85% of infected children were unvaccinated. Cases are concentrated in Zhambyl region in the southeast (191 cases). The country reported 4,240 cases last year, and estimates indicate 24,000–28,000 cases in 2024. Authorities say vaccination coverage among target-age children is low and refusals have increased, which has sustained the outbreak. The United States has reported 171 confirmed cases this year across 9 states, 2 of them hospitalised. Most cases are in South Carolina (145 confirmed). The state has identified 409 contacts and plans monitoring until 9 February. 95% of patients in the country were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. US vaccination rates have continued to lag in recent years, and recent activity is concentrated in South Carolina and Utah.

se5q3gb6ieXETlAIxBo-hA.zh: 哈薩克南部突厥斯坦州報告1例炭疽病例,病患曾接觸並食用感染動物,醫院治療中,接觸者檢驗皆呈陰性,當局表示本案源自私人屠宰場於宰殺牛隻時,違反衛生相關規定,已公告民眾應至有獸醫認證標誌之官方銷售點購買肉品。
se5q3gb6ieXETlAIxBo-hA.en: One anthrax case was reported in the Turkistan region of southern Kazakhstan. The patient had handled and eaten an infected animal and is being treated in hospital; all tests on contacts were negative. Authorities say the case originated from a private slaughterhouse that violated hygiene regulations when slaughtering cattle. The public has been advised to buy meat only at official sales points that carry a veterinary certification mark.

INNLAD2WtPbDlgaHXXQk4g.zh: 哈薩克南部克孜勒奧爾達州今年累計報告22例疑病例,其中12例確診,該州今年迄今超過1,200名居民遭蜱蟲叮咬接受治療,目前與感染者接觸人員均接受觀察,目前尚無出現異常情形。當局已針對當地熱點地區進行消毒及防治措施。
INNLAD2WtPbDlgaHXXQk4g.en: In Kyzylorda region in southern Kazakhstan, 22 suspected cases were reported cumulatively this year, of which 12 were confirmed. More than 1,200 residents of the region have been treated for tick bites so far this year. People in contact with infected patients are under observation, and no abnormalities have been found so far. Authorities have carried out disinfection and control measures in local hotspot areas.

Vcct-jKMINHMXGP-rEE8ZA.zh: 哈薩克北部阿克莫拉州6/17-7/4報告13例確定病例及數頭牛隻死亡,當局實施隔離措施及牛隻疫苗接種作業後,疫情獲控制並於7/21宣布解除,本次感染源為不明炭疽病之屍體埋葬地和野外囓齒動物之洞穴。
Vcct-jKMINHMXGP-rEE8ZA.en: In Akmola Region of northern Kazakhstan, 13 confirmed cases and several cattle deaths were reported from 17 June to 4 July. After quarantine measures and cattle vaccination, the outbreak was brought under control, and it was declared over on 21 July. The source of infection was the burial site of animal carcasses from an unidentified anthrax cause, and burrows of wild rodents.

s3kVCb0PwNRypNg52i9eUg.zh: 哈薩克北部阿克莫拉州報告5例皮膚炭疽病例,病患皆住院治療且病況穩定,當局已針對該區牛隻屠宰場及放牧場域啟動調查及防治措施,其中部分(3/9)環境樣本檢出陽性。
s3kVCb0PwNRypNg52i9eUg.en: Five cutaneous anthrax cases were reported in Akmola Region in northern Kazakhstan. All patients are hospitalized and in stable condition. Authorities have launched investigation and control measures at cattle slaughterhouses and grazing areas in the area, and some environmental samples (3 of 9) tested positive.

Mw9m_iVx8q8VGEwR_Wb-TA.zh: EURO公布歐洲及中亞於2024年報告12.7萬餘例,為2023年之2倍,亦為1997年以來新高,超過40%為5歲以下兒童,逾半數住院治療,截至今年3/6累計報告38例死亡;羅馬亞去年報告逾3萬例,為該區域最高,其次為哈薩克2.8萬餘例。WHO表示自1997年以來病例數持續下降,惟新冠疫情期間疫苗覆蓋率下滑,使2023-2024年病例數大幅增加,全球去年報告近36萬例,歐洲區病例數約佔1/3。
Mw9m_iVx8q8VGEwR_Wb-TA.en: EURO reports that Europe and Central Asia recorded over 127,000 measles cases in 2024, double the 2023 figure and the highest since 1997. Over 40% were children under 5, and more than half were hospitalized. As of 6 March this year, 38 deaths had been reported cumulatively. Romania reported over 30,000 cases last year, the highest in the region, followed by Kazakhstan with over 28,000. WHO notes that case numbers had been declining since 1997, but falling vaccination coverage during the COVID-19 pandemic caused a sharp rise in cases in 2023–2024. Globally, nearly 360,000 cases were reported last year, and the European Region accounted for about one third of them.
